name: mikelocal-desktop
description: Mike — local desktop AI legal platform (Electron shell over the upstream Next.js + Express app)

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.electron:lock-only: npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/stage-frontend.js
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend run build && node scripts/stage-backend.js
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dist: npm run fetch:libreoffice && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:trace: npm run fetch:libreoffice && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
